tools.name: list_pathways
tools.description:
List the citizenship-by-descent pathways this server can evaluate.

    Call this before check_descent_eligibility if you are unsure whether a
    country is covered. Countries marked 'planned' have no rules implemented —
    do not guess an answer for them.

tools.name: check_descent_eligibility
tools.description:
Check whether a person qualifies for citizenship by descent.

    Give the user's direct ancestral line, one entry per generation, starting
    with relation='self'. Every generation between the user and the ancestor
    must be present even if little is known about them, because descent passes

tools.name: get_pathway_requirements
tools.description:
Documents, cost, and processing time for a supported descent pathway.

    Use after check_descent_eligibility returns green or yellow, when the user
    asks what they actually have to gather.
